decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted, i.e. In respect of walls, roofs and fenestration, shall match those used in the existing building.  Materials to be used at ground floor and first floor level shall reflect the existing materials used at ground and first floor levels.

Condition : 3 - The roof area of the single storey extension shall not be altered or adapted for use as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 3 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification) no windows or other openings (other than those expressly authorised by this permission) shall be formed in the walls or roof of the extension permitted.
Condition : 5 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No.4 Fareham Road, Feltham.
description: Erection of two-storey side and part two storey and part single storey side/rear extension to house following removal of existing detached side garage extension to the house
